corrections.corrected_text: ፳፭ ፤ ⟪ወይቤሎ ፡ ጳውሎስ ፡ እበድሰ ፡ አልብየ ፡ ኦ ፡ ፊ
corrections.reason: The Ge'ez vocative particle 'ኦ' (translated in the following Amharic commentary line as 'ሆይ') is preceded by a wordspace colon that had faint ink, causing Stage 1 to merge it as 'አልብየእ'.
The single glyph 'ኀ' between 'ይ' and 'ስ' was misread as two characters 'ካሰ'. Visually there are six characters 'ይኀስብናል' ('he wishes/thinks [chains] upon us').
The printed word has two characters 'ገዡ' (with the 2nd-order vowel stroke on 'ዡ'), which Stage 1 split into 'ገዢዩ'.
